risks.risk: TCPA/CAN-SPAM or state wiretap liability if Phase 1 accidentally enables automated outreach or recording.
risks.mitigation: Fail-closed consent gates; no automated send/record in Phase 1; legal policy chosen before Phase 2.

risks.risk: Scraped review data may be inaccurate or stale, producing a bad meeting kit.
risks.mitigation: Label all scraped fields as THINK/GUESS; founder can edit before call.

risks.risk: Website scoring designed for site-builder may not translate to therapist-specific insights.
risks.mitigation: Add therapist-specific heuristics and prompt layer; measure usefulness after 5 calls.

risks.risk: Building a parallel CRM instead of reusing Outreach CRM creates data drift.
risks.mitigation: Reuse crm_contacts and outbound_consent; add only side tables for kit-specific data.

risks.risk: Recording consent model complexity delays Phase 2 indefinitely.
risks.mitigation: Phase 1 ships without recording; Phase 2 gated on explicit founder legal decision.

risks.risk: Reusing existing sales_call_recordings/coaching_clips tables without a migration could couple SalesOS to BoldTrail or break existing LifeRE routes.
risks.mitigation: Make Phase 0 schema decision before any code; if reusing, add nullable user_id/practice_id and decouple from boldtrail_agents; if not, create new salesos_* tables.

risks.risk: The Human Performance Engine is built too early, producing ungrounded coaching suggestions without real call data.
risks.mitigation: Explicitly defer HPE to Phase 4; reuse decision_outcome_ledger, lumin-communication-guard, and deterministic gates for Phase 1–3.
